mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment above 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below the 5-year average signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of below-average RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising FEDFUNDS above 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index above its 12-month moving average signals improving manufacturing activity and higher corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising INDPRO above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 5-year average signals weakening residential investment, reducing construction-related earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of below-average HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening labor demand, supporting earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI inflation rate below 1.5% signals easing price pressures, reducing the real cost of capital and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of below-target CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05).
